capabilities: Start typing sessions on the active note, random paragraphs, or a section from the Outline panel
Switch between 10FastFingers and on-note views, content styles, and timed or untimed sessions
Show live and end-of-session WPM, accuracy, consistency, and trouble words
Drill the words missed in a session or retry the same paragraph
Add a ghost typist and progress race rail that types at a target pace
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no screenshots or screenshots-free docs, but it is complete on setup, modes, settings, results and platform support.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to practise typing or reinforce memory by retyping your own notes, so users must copy text into separate typing sites.

relations.evidence: 10fastfingers / on note | Switch between the two views

summary: Typing-practice plugin that lets you retype your own notes in timed sessions, tracking speed, accuracy and trouble words.
